description: This file defines the enum `GuarantorFundStatusType`, representing different status states of a guarantor's fund within the loan guarantor domain of the Fineract project. It includes status constants, methods to map integers to enum instances, and methods to check specific states like active, completed, withdrawn, or deleted.

classes.name: GuarantorFundStatusType
classes.description: Enum representing different guarantor fund status states such as INVALID, ACTIVE, COMPLETED, WITHDRAWN, and DELETED, with utility methods for status checks.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to its corresponding GuarantorFundStatusType enum value.

methods.name: hasStateOf
methods.description: Checks if the current enum instance has the same state as another specified GuarantorFundStatusType.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the enum instance.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code string associated with the enum instance.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns true if the status is ACTIVE.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Returns true if the status is withdrawn, completed, or deleted.

methods.name: isWithdrawn
methods.description: Returns true if the status is WITHDRAWN.

methods.name: isCompleted
methods.description: Returns true if the status is COMPLETED.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Returns true if the status is DELETED.
